home.metaDescription: A look at Chata CRM — cottage management for the whole family.

hero.title: Everyone's plans, one shared place
hero.description: Stays, supplies, tasks, and notes — for every family member who shares the cottage, without the group chat chaos

visits.title: Stays, without the double-booking
visits.description: One shared calendar the whole family checks before they pack — no more two households showing up the same weekend

shopping.title: One list, always current
shopping.description: Everyone sees what's missing and what's already covered, so nobody buys a third bag of charcoal by accident

tasks.title: Nothing lost between visits
tasks.description: To-dos and short notes carry over from one stay to the next, so small jobs don't get forgotten all summer

presence.title: See who's there, right now
presence.caption: The home screen shows who's at the cottage today and who's arriving next — no group chat archaeology required

calendar.title: Plan the next stay in seconds
calendar.caption: Add a visit, pick the dates, done. Everyone with access sees it update immediately

shopping.title: Keep supplies stocked
shopping.caption: Check items off as you buy them. The list resets itself for the next stay, not the next argument

tasks.title: Never lose a task
tasks.caption: Small maintenance jobs get logged once and stay visible until someone marks them done

closing.title: Ready to see it live?
closing.description: Create an account and explore the full app in a couple of minutes — no credit card, no commitment
